en: ARCHIVIN is a vintage shop in Haebangchon, Seoul. We carry band tees, tour merch, film and skate graphics, and designer pieces from the 1970s to the 2010s.
Every piece is one of one. When it sells, it goes to the archive.
about.ko: 해방촌의 빈티지 숍 아카이빈이에요. 1970년대부터 2010년대까지의 밴드 티셔츠와 디자이너 피스를 한 점씩만 소개해요.
